turns.text: Hello... um. I have a booking.
Hello, I can help with that. Could I have your booking code and last name?
Thank you, Mr. Alves. I see your Dubai to Paris flight on Friday at 09:00. What would you like to do?
Of course. Would you like to move to a later flight on Friday, or a different day?
We have SK312 to Paris on Friday at 19:15. Would the evening flight work for you?
Your booking is from 10 days ago, so there's a $75 change fee on Economy, plus the $15 fare difference, since SK312 is $445 and you're at $430. Is that okay?
All done. You're now on SK312 to Paris on Friday at 19:15, with $90 in total charges.
